raw_url.description: The raw bytes exactly as received.

seen_at.description: When it was first seen, Unix milliseconds.

sequence.description: For a version found in mail: its `SEQUENCE`.

auth.description: `password` (default; HTTP Basic) or `token` (bearer token, such as a Fastmail API token).

name.description: Shown in the sidebar; the user name, or the server's host for a token, when missing.

password.description: The password, app password or API token.

url.description:
The session address, e.g. `https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session`, or the server's
address, where `/.well-known/jmap` is asked. `https` only.

username.description: Needed for `password`; may be empty for `token`.

JmapConnectionDto.description: How a JMAP account connects. The password or token is never returned.

exclude.description: Mailbox paths that are not archived.

username.description: Empty for a token without a user name.

JmapConnectionRequest.description:
A new connection for a JMAP account, checked by signing in before it is stored. Moving
between `password` and `token` needs a new secret in `password`.

url.description:
The session address, e.g. `https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session`, or the server's
address, where `/.well-known/jmap` is asked.

username.description: Needed for `password`; may be empty for `token`.

people.description: Two or more person ids of one archive.

LabelDto.description: A label of an archive's messages, as Gmail has them.

name.description: The label, e.g. `Inbox` or `Projects/2025`; nested labels use `/`.

unread.description: Of those, the ones not read in any folder they are in.

oneOf.description:
The newest entry; write its `seq` and `hash` down elsewhere to prove later that nothing
up to it changed.
The last finished verification.

hash.description: BLAKE3 over the entry and the hash before it, 64 hex digits.

anchor_seq.description: The position of the anchor it was given.

blobs_checked.description: Message bytes read, when it was asked to read them.

problems.description: At most 100 lines with ids and positions.

LocationDto.description: A folder a message is in.

removed_at.description: Unix milliseconds when it disappeared from the folder on the server.

ManualAliasRequest.description: Adds an alias by hand, e.g. an Apple Hide My Email address.

provider.description: A provider id, or any lowercase name.

MeetingDto.description: An event a person organizes or attends.

group_id.description: The event with its copies: open it at `/api/events/{group_id}`.

removed_at.description: When it was removed from its calendar, Unix milliseconds.

status.description: Their lowercase `PARTSTAT` as an attendee, such as `accepted`.

MessageAliasDto.description: The alias a message was forwarded to.

known.description: The alias is known: listed by a service or added by hand.

reverse_alias.description: The address that reaches the sender through the service.

oneOf.description: Who really sent it, when the service hid them.

signed.description: The provider's signature passed; without it the forwarding fields may be forged.

MessageDetail.description: Everything the reader shows about a message, except its HTML body.

oneOf.description: The alias it was forwarded or addressed to, with the sender the service hid.

has_html.description: Whether `GET /api/messages/{id}/body` has an HTML body to show.

oneOf.description: Codes and unsubscribe links found in it; absent when the server computes no insights.

invitations.description:
The events its calendar parts (invitations, updates, replies, cancellations) belong to,
as the archive knows them now; empty when it has none.

people.description:
The people of its `From`, `To`, `Cc`, `Bcc` and `Reply-To` addresses, for those that
belong to one, each address once.

preview.description: One line from the start of the body.

references.description: `References` ids without angle brackets, oldest first.

MessageInsightsDto.description: What was found in a message.

items.description: `Likely` and `Certain` items, and `Possible` ones the server is set to show.

own.description: The `From` is one of the archive's own addresses: an account's or an alias's.

oneOf.description: Present when the message declares a way to unsubscribe.

MessagePage.description: One page of a message list.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; absent on the last page.

attachment_match.description:
In search results: the words were found only in text inside its attachments. Always
`false` in folder and label lists.

date.description: Unix milliseconds; what lists sort by.

flags.description:
IMAP flags and keywords such as `\Seen` and `\Flagged`: those in the listed folder, or
the union over every folder the message is in.

folder_ids.description: Folders the message is in now.

insight_kinds.description:
The kinds of insight found in it (`code`, `unsubscribe`, ...), never their values. `code`
is left out for members and on the archive's own mail.

thread_count.description: Messages in its thread, itself included.

NewAliasServiceRequest.description: Connects an account at an alias service.

base_url.description: Another address, for a self-hosted service.

archives.description: Archive ids the user may read.

role.description: `owner`, `admin` or `member` (default). Only an owner adds owners.

url.description: An `http://` or `https://` address without a user name or password.

pasted_url.description: The address the browser landed on after sign-in, or its query.

OAuthProviderDto.description: A provider this server signs in with.

thunderbird_client.description: Thunderbird's public client is used, so the consent screen names Thunderbird.

authorize_url.description: Open this page to sign in with the provider.

expires_at.description: When the sign-in stops being accepted, Unix milliseconds.

needs_paste.description:
After sign-in the browser lands on a page that does not load; paste its address to
`/api/oauth/finish`. When `false`, the provider returns to `/api/oauth/callback`, which
finishes on its own and sends the browser back to `return_to`.

state.description: Ties the answer to this sign-in.

thunderbird_client.description: Thunderbird's public client is used, so the consent screen names Thunderbird.

OAuthStartRequest.description:
Starts a Gmail or Microsoft sign-in. Give `archive_id` for a new account, or `account_id` to
sign in again to an existing IMAP or Graph account.

email.description: The address to sign in as. Ignored when signing in again to an OAuth account.

kind.description:
How a new account reads mail: `imap` (the default) or `graph` (Microsoft Graph, for
`microsoft` only). Ignored when signing in again: the account's kind decides.

name.description: Shown in the sidebar for a new account; the address when missing.

return_to.description: A path in the web app the callback returns to, e.g. `/settings`; `/settings` when missing.

OneClickDto.description: Whether the server can unsubscribe with one click.

oneOf.description: Why not, when not available.

OneClickReasonDto.description: Why one-click unsubscribe is not offered.

PersonAttachmentDto.description: A file exchanged with a person.

PersonCardDto.description: One of a person's contact cards.

readable.description: Whether its latest version could be read.

removed_at.description: When it was removed from its source, Unix milliseconds.

seen_at.description: When it was last known as it is, Unix milliseconds.

cards.description: Their cards, the current ones first.

fields.description: Their fields merged from every card, with where each value comes from.

links.description: The shared addresses and phone numbers that made the cards one person.

meetings.description:
Events whose organizer or attendees include them, the latest start first, at most 50;
copies of one event in several calendars once.

overrides.description: Splits and joins made by hand that touch one of their cards or addresses, oldest first.

PersonDto.description: A user as owners and admins see them.

archives.description: Archives granted to the user. Owners and admins read every archive regardless.

PersonFieldDto.description: A field of a person merged from their cards.

differs.description: Whether their current cards disagree on it.

PersonLinkDto.description: Why two cards are the same person.

kind.description: `email`, `phone`, or `hand` for a join made by hand.

value.description: The shared address, the phone number in E.164 form, or the join's id.

PersonOverrideDto.description:
A split or join of people made by hand. It names cards and addresses, never person ids, so
it holds through every rebuild of the people.

from.description: A split: the cards they were separated from. Empty for a join.

keys.description:
A join: what is one person, as `item:<item id>` for a card or `email:<address>` for a
person from mail. A split: the cards moved out, as `item:<item id>`.

people.description:
The people that hold its keys now, each once: for a join in the order of its keys, for a
split the people of `from` first.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; absent on the last page.

total.description: How many people match the filters, on every page.

PersonSummaryDto.description:
A person in a list: contact cards grouped by a shared email address or phone number, or an
address from mail alone.

cards.description: How many contact cards; 0 for a person from mail alone.

collection_ids.description: The address books of their cards.

differences.description: Whether their current cards disagree on a field.

email.description: The email address to show first.

first_message_at.description: The oldest of those messages, Unix milliseconds.

from_me.description: Messages the archive's owner sent to them.

id.description: Stable across rebuilds while the group keeps its smallest email address or phone.

last_message_at.description: The newest of those messages, Unix milliseconds.

messages.description: Messages with one of their addresses, counted per address.

name.description: The name most of their cards give, else the name their mail is written with most.

phone.description: The phone number to show first, in E.164 form when known.

phones.description: Every phone number in E.164 form.

removed.description: Whether every card was removed and no mail keeps them.

removed_cards.description: How many of those were removed from their source.

last_at.description: The newest one's date, Unix milliseconds.

message_id.description: The newest message of theirs in it; open it in the reader.

ProfileRequest.description: Changes to your own profile; missing fields stay as they are.

changed.description: Instances changed or cancelled apart from the series.

frequency.description:
`YEARLY`, `MONTHLY`, `WEEKLY`, `DAILY`, `HOURLY`, `MINUTELY` or `SECONDLY`; absent when
the rule cannot be read.

last_end.description: The last end, Unix milliseconds; absent when it repeats without end.

rule.description: The `RRULE` as written; absent when it repeats by `RDATE` alone.

failed.description: Images that could not be saved.

older_pending.description: Messages archived before saving was turned on and not looked at yet.

since.description: When saving was turned on, Unix milliseconds; `null` while it is off.

RemoteImagesRequest.description: Which remote image work to start.

job.description:
`older`: images of mail archived before saving was turned on. `failed`: fetch again the
images that could not be saved.

RemoteMode.description: What to do with remote images in an HTML body.

RuleDayDto.description: A weekday of a rule, with its ordinal: `{ ordinal: -1, weekday: "FR" }` is the last Friday.

next_offset.description: Pass as `offset` for the next page; absent on the last page.

SetupRequest.description: Creates the owner with the one-time setup token.

token.description: The `token` query parameter of the setup link.

SetupStatusDto.description: Whether the instance still needs its owner.

needed.description: `true` while there are no users; the web app then shows the setup screen.

SmtpDto.description: The SMTP listener, from the server's config.

enabled.description: `false` when the config has no `[smtp]`; the other fields are then empty.

folder.description: The folder of the archive's "Received by SMTP" account.

journal.description: Exchange journal reports are unwrapped to the original message.

SourceMessageDto.description: A message a version of an item was found in.

SplitRequest.description: Cards to move out of a person into a person of their own.

cards.description: Item ids of some of the person's cards, not all of them.

SyncScheduleDto.description: The sync interval of accounts without their own.

from_config.description: Set in the server's config; the API cannot change it.

minutes.description: Minutes between syncs; 0 means only on request.

SyncScheduleRequest.description: A new sync interval for accounts without their own.

minutes.description: Minutes between syncs, at most a week; 0 syncs only on request.

state.description:
`running`, `done`, `failed`, `cancelled`, or `interrupted` when the server stopped while it
ran.

total.description: `null` when the amount of work is not known.

TaskLineDto.description: One line of a task's log.

TrustDto.description: The sender trust of a message. Always `unknown` for now.

TrustStateDto.description: Whether the sender is who the message says.

UnsubscribeDto.description: How to leave the list a message came from.

mailto.description: A `mailto:` URI, opened by the reader's own mail program.

UserDto.description: A user who can sign in.

UserUpdateRequest.description: Changes to a user; missing fields stay as they are.

password.description: A new password; ends the user's sessions.

ValueSourceDto.description: Where a value of a person's field comes from.

account_name.description:
The account the address book was read from; absent for imported files and removed
accounts.

removed.description: Whether the card was removed from its source.

seen_at.description:
When the card was last known to say this, Unix milliseconds: when it was removed, else
when its address book last synced, else when its latest version was seen.

anchor.description: A head written down earlier, as `<seq>:<hash>`.

blobs.description: Also read every message's bytes and compare their hash; as slow as reading the archive.

WatchDto.description: Which folders of an account are watched for changes.

folders.description:
The watched folder paths for `folders`; a server without `NOTIFY` watches the first
three.

mode.description: `off`, `inbox` (the default; the all-mail folder on Gmail) or `folders`.

WatchStateDto.description: What a watch is doing now.

state.description:
`off`, `starting`, `live` (changes start a sync within seconds), `polling` (the server
cannot push) or `reconnecting`.

WebhookCreatedDto.description: A webhook with its signing secret, shown only when it is made.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for `Holtmail-Signature`; keep it now, it is not shown again.

WebhookDto.description: An address the server tells about events.

oneOf.description: Its newest delivery.

WebhookListDto.description: The webhooks and the events they can get.

events.description: Every event name a webhook can subscribe to.

WebhookUpdateRequest.description: Changes a webhook; missing fields stay.
